theorem_scope: Two unsigned i64 quotient/remainder pairs, with x2=(x+1) mod 2^64, y2=(y+1) mod 2^64; first-trap site when y=0, second-trap site when y=UINT64_MAX, finite otherwise. Euclidean quotient and remainder contract assumed. No native compiler proof.
